limitations: The release confirms Standard Chartered custody support is live but describes LMAX collateral integration as planned.
The release does not establish that collateral eligibility or collateral mirroring is already active in production.
Ripple is a transaction party and issuer ecosystem participant; claims are retained as issuer/counterparty statements.
The future collateral capability remains subject to documentation, testing, law, internal approval and jurisdictional readiness.
The release says Ripple will provide $150 million in financing to support LMAX's growth strategy.
No drawdown, disbursement, settlement receipt or current outstanding balance was verified; do not count this as cash received.
The release says Coinbase Global Exchange collateral availability will follow; no production activation evidence was found.
Coinbase is the distribution/platform provider, not RLUSD's issuer.
The announcement establishes RLUSD availability on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Retail, not a Coinbase acquisition or issuer role.
Global Exchange collateral support is future, not live, in the announcement.
The launch notice classifies RLUSD as a Type 4 electronic payment instrument under SBI VC Trade's Japanese-law interpretation.
The notice explicitly limits VCTRADE deposits and withdrawals to Ethereum at launch; BITPOINT is excluded.
This is a service-specific limitation, not a claim that RLUSD does not exist on XRPL globally.
The official article describes Ethereum as the first SBI VC Trade service network and says chain support may expand.
No later official SBI VC Trade notice confirming XRPL deposits/withdrawals was found through the research cutoff.
The final OCC approval is not proof that the bank has commenced customer operations.
Ripple says Standard Custody & Trust Company remains the RLUSD issuer; Ripple National Trust Bank has separate reserve, collateral-trustee and custody permissions.
The $2.627B circulation and $2.7586B reserve figures are issuer dashboard observations as of October 29.
The dashboard lists monthly CPA attestation reports through September 2026; the October 29 balance snapshot is not itself an October CPA attestation.
Original dashboard bytes and the linked CPA report files were not captured.

instrument_separation.rlusd: USD-backed stablecoin issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company; used for payments, settlement, custody and potential collateral workflows.
instrument_separation.xrp: Native XRPL digital asset; distinct from RLUSD and not the subject of the RLUSD collateral announcements.
instrument_separation.coinbase: Platform/distribution partner for RLUSD; not the issuer.
instrument_separation.ripple_national_trust_bank: Separate OCC-approved trust-bank entity; not the RLUSD issuer.
instrument_separation.sbi_vc_trade: SBI Holdings subsidiary and Japanese distribution venue; its service-specific chain support must not be inferred from global RLUSD network availability.
instrument_separation.sbic: Japan's regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies are unrelated to SBI VC Trade's corporate subsidiary relationship in these releases.

capital_reconciliation.rule: Do not count the $150M as cash received by LMAX or XRP-market capital without a funding/drawdown receipt or filing.
capital_reconciliation.collateral_rule: RLUSD collateral plans and RLUSD custody are not XRP collateral or XRP purchases.

competing_hypotheses.claim: RLUSD adoption on XRPL can increase XRPL utility and transaction activity without materially increasing direct XRP market demand.
support: RLUSD is available on XRPL through multiple platforms.
Standard Chartered's institutional custody of RLUSD on XRPL is reported live.
disconfirming_or_missing: No quantified incremental XRPL transaction fees, reserve demand, market-maker inventory or XRP purchases are supplied.
No before/after activity attribution is available.

competing_hypotheses.claim: RLUSD can complement XRP bridge liquidity by supplying stable USD legs and enabling institutional workflows.
support: Ripple positions RLUSD across payments, trading and institutional infrastructure.
Coinbase supports RLUSD across XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
disconfirming_or_missing: No corridor-level evidence shows RLUSD settlement causes incremental XRP bridge volume.
Stablecoin settlement can also route without XRP.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Some USD settlement flows may use RLUSD directly and reduce the need to bridge through XRP for those specific legs.
support: RLUSD is a USD-denominated settlement asset with institutional distribution and custody.
SBI VC Trade and Coinbase provide distribution routes.
disconfirming_or_missing: No quantified displacement of XRP bridge transactions or payment volumes is available.
Different corridor, liquidity and FX requirements may make RLUSD and XRP complementary.

data_quality.source_independence: Multiple corporate counterparties independently publish parts of the same transactions; no raw byte captures or external timestamp anchors were obtained.
reasons: All source material is web-rendered or search-extract evidence rather than byte-complete captures.
Future collateral features are not live and must not enter current-use features.
Issuer dashboard reserve figures are not a same-date independent CPA attestation.
Financing commitment is not verified as disbursed capital.

predictions.reason: Institutional RLUSD custody, distribution and collateral announcements do not establish XRP spot demand or collateral utilization.

next_actions: Obtain the October RLUSD CPA attestation when published and reconcile it to the October 29 dashboard snapshot.
Verify whether Standard Chartered/LMAX collateral mirroring has passed documentation, testing, approvals and gone live.
Check Coinbase Global Exchange collateral launch separately from Coinbase Prime/Exchange/Retail RLUSD distribution.
Check SBI VC Trade official network support notices for any XRPL deposit/withdrawal expansion; do not infer it from global RLUSD support.
Seek a primary filing or transaction record confirming whether the $150M LMAX financing commitment was funded.
Track RLUSD supply and activity by chain separately from XRP exchange flows, XRP collateral, and XRP bridge-settlement volumes.
